instruction: Remodel a compact school from the provided IFC. Open C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit and use C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png as the visual reference for the starting condition. Remodel the building into a compact two-storey school and export the final IFC4 model to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. The final IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, two IfcBuildingStorey entities, nine IfcSpace objects, eight IfcWall elements, two IfcSlab elements, and one IfcStair. Name the spaces so they include at least six Classroom spaces, two Toilet spaces, and one Administration space; the two toilet spaces must be named exactly Toilet Block 1 and Toilet Block 2. The final export should not include IfcRoof, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, IfcCurtainWall, IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcColumn, or IfcBeam entities. The init model is a starting file to remodel, not a sufficient final answer. Other layout details may vary, but all IfcRoot GlobalIds must be unique. [Software] Launch Revit with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`.
